text:
We checked “2 var fonts” and found one issue in the InDesign file that is likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 2 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Variable font used
Frontify doesn’t support variable fonts, so text using them won’t render correctly.
Where: the font “Roboto Mono”
• Install the static (non-variable) version of the font and swap it in with Type > Find/Replace Font.
Learn more

May change how it looks

2. Document has bleed
Bleed is added to every export, which is right for print templates but usually unwanted for digital ones.
Current bleed: 3 mm on all sides
• For a digital template, set bleed to 0 in File > Document Setup > Bleed and Slug. For print templates, bleed is fine.
Learn more

3. Item is rotated
Rotation works, but the item may look slightly different in Frontify than in InDesign.
Where: a text frame on page 1
• Check the result in Frontify. If it looks off, remove the rotation.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
